recent_posts.title: The making of DON'T CHICKEN OUT - a multiplayer rage game
recent_posts.summary: A devlog about the development of 'Don't Chicken Out', a cooperative multiplayer rage game made by two brothers using Unity. The game features two chickens balancing an egg through increasingly difficult zones (farm, city, jungle, Himalayas, space). Key development highlights include the art style evolution from atmospheric silhouettes to bold cartoony visuals, the challenge of implementing online multiplayer using Photon Fusion, and the iterative process of prototyping multiple game concepts before settling on this one. A free demo is available on Steam.

recent_posts.title: Don't Chicken Out is a new co-op indie game about balancing an egg
recent_posts.summary: Don't Chicken Out is a co-op indie game where two players control separate chickens carrying a shared basket with an egg balanced on it. Each player can only move their own chicken, and coordinating movements is essential to prevent the egg from rolling off. The game features a colorful obstacle course that demands tight communication and coordination between players.

recent_posts.title: Developer considers adding tiny basket hardcore mode to rage co-op game
recent_posts.summary: A game developer is considering adding an extra difficulty mode ('tiny basket mode') to their rage co-op game 'Don't Chicken Out', where players balance an egg in a much smaller basket. The post asks the community for feedback on whether to include this hardcore challenge mode, and promotes the game's Steam wishlist page.

recent_posts.title: Dev speedrun fantasy vs reality meme promoting a Steam game
recent_posts.summary: A humorous post comparing the idealized 'speedrun' fantasy of game development against the frustrating reality, promoting a game called 'Don't Chicken Out' on Steam.

recent_posts.title: Blackthornprod's NEXT Steam Game (2 weeks of indie game dev)
recent_posts.summary: A devlog from Blackthornprod covering two weeks of indie game development, exploring two game prototypes. The first is a dark medieval medical simulator where players diagnose and treat patients with fantastical diseases, using tools like leeches and syringes while managing reputation. The second is a relaxing incremental market/farming game set in southern France, featuring plant symbiosis mechanics, life cycles, and upgrades. The post also includes a sketchbook tour showing anatomical studies and travel drawings from Istanbul, highlighting how real-world observation fuels game art and design.

recent_posts.title: We made 9 VIDEO GAMES in 9 days!
BLACKTHORNPROD responds to criticism and announces 2026 plans
recent_posts.summary: BLACKTHORNPROD addresses recent criticism about their Game Dev Rocket course marketing and game development challenges. They apologize for misleading testimonials and unclear marketing claims, while defending their teaching credentials and challenge format. The channel plans to refocus on free YouTube tutorials, devlogs for their new game "Cooking in Silence", and Unity/C# educational content in 2026, offering a free beginner course to start.

recent_posts.title: The Art of Blackthornprod (14 to 25 years old)
recent_posts.summary: A personal journey through 11 years of art development, from early 3D modeling with Autodesk Maya at age 14 to traditional drawing after a stroke at 23. The creator shares their evolution from digital game art (2016-2022) to daily pencil practice, emphasizing consistent morning sessions, life drawing, and balancing observational work with imagination. Key projects include various indie games with distinct art styles, portrait studies, and watercolor fantasy illustrations inspired by Dungeons & Dragons.

top_posts.title: Five developers independently build a Hollow Knight inspired game in seven days
top_posts.summary: Five game developers independently create a Hollow Knight-inspired game in seven days without communication. Each developer contributes their specialty: hand-drawn 2D art and animations for the character Sherma and boss enemies, Unity programming for player controls and physics, music composition and audio implementation, sound effects and level design. The project demonstrates collaborative game development workflow, covering character animation, boss mechanics, parallax environments, shader programming, particle systems, and audio integration using Unity's input system and Cinemachine.

top_posts.title: Five developers build a game without communication
top_posts.summary: Five developers collaborate on creating a game about anteaters and ants without communicating with each other. Each developer builds upon the previous work, adding mechanics like hunger systems, enemy jaguars, fruit collection, environmental art, sound effects, and UI improvements. The project evolves from a simple anteater with a tongue attack into a complete game where players collect fruit, manage hunger, avoid predators, and build a home. The experiment showcases how iterative development works when developers can only respond to existing code and assets.

top_posts.title: Developers create horror games in different engines within tight deadlines
top_posts.summary: Four game developers use Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot, and physical materials to create survival horror games within tight time constraints. Each developer tackles the challenge with different strategies and tools, showcasing quick prototyping and creative problem-solving. From run-and-gun gameplay and next bot horror to board game mechanics, they demonstrate the versatility of various game engines in creating unique horror experiences.

top_posts.title: Six developers create platformer game in Godot without communication
top_posts.summary: Six developers collaborate on creating a platformer game using Godot without communicating with each other. Each developer adds their own features including a swinging chain mechanic, 3D character in 2D world, enemy AI, audio effects, level design, and story elements. The final result is a tiger-themed action platformer with grappling hook mechanics, multiple levels, and a complete game experience from menu to ending.

top_posts.title: Five developers create a game without communicating
top_posts.summary: Five developers take on the challenge of creating a video game using Unreal Engine without communicating with each other. This project explores various stages of game development, from initial level design and basic mechanics to AI behavior, adding features, and fixing bugs. The final product is a unique and somewhat chaotic game that showcases each developer’s contributions and creativity.
